Aditya Aswani.

Writer, Buddhist meditator, and animal-rights defendant — currently facing a felony charge for rescuing dogs from a research lab in Wisconsin.

This site is where I keep my work in one place: the case I’m defending in court, the meditation communities I help run, and the essays I publish on Substack about the slow collisions between practice and the world.
